name: orb_vwap_confirmation_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's first 20 minutes (09:15-09:35) absorbs overnight information and institutional positioning; the resulting range high/low represents the equilibrium where buyers and sellers balanced. When NIFTY closes above the ORB high AND is meaningfully above session VWAP with the ORB high itself already above VWAP (structural alignment), VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms — who must fill directional mandates at or better than their VWAP benchmark — are already net buyers AND have pushed through the opening supply ceiling. A 2-bar (10s) persistence filter eliminates the frequent algo-driven stop-hunt spikes that briefly breach the ORB level before collapsing, selecting only breakouts sustained by genuine order flow. The combination (spatial: VWAP position + structural alignment; temporal: 10s persistence) identifies institutional breakout conviction rather than a mechanical price-level probe.
core_signal_oneliner: 20-minute ORB breakout requiring structural VWAP alignment (ORB high itself above VWAP) plus 2-bar persistence and volume confirmation
